summary: InPoint Commercial Real Estate Income, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose its July 31, 2026 NAV per share of $13.13, calculated per board-approved guidelines. The filing details asset and liability components, including commercial mortgage loans, real estate, repurchase agreements, and preferred stock, with NAV attributable to common stock of $132.9 million across 10.1 million shares. This is a routine periodic NAV update for a non-traded REIT, not a special situation. No transaction or strategic event is involved. What to watch: future NAV trends and potential liquidity events, but no immediate action is indicated.
